review: 1:2 שֵׂה הָרַחֲמִים — 'Lamb of the Mercies', for يَا حَمَلَ الرَّحْمٰن; the plural רַחֲמִים is the biblical form of the divine compassion (Ps 25:6).
1:4 עֶבֶד נִשְׁמָע — 'an obedient servant'; נִשְׁמָע is the niphal participle of שָׁמַע used for obedience in 1 Sam 15:22, and it keeps the passive sense of يَطُوع.
3:2 אַתָּה תַּנְחֵנִי — the Arabic is an imperative (كُنْ مُرْشِدِي); Hebrew uses the imperfect because a pointed imperative of נחה would be תְּנַחֵנִי, which reads as a statement.
4:3 אֶחֱזֶה הַמָּשִׁיחַ הַפָּצוּעַ — 'I shall behold the wounded Christ'; the Arabic names the side (بِجَنْبِهِ الْجَرِيح), Hebrew compresses it into the adjective because the line has 11 syllables.
